title: Unsupervised pretraining in biological neural networks
goal: Reproduce the original biological findings on stimulus selectivity and decorrelation, reward-predictive activity and pretraining-related learning benefit, using the complete source-defined cohorts and indispensable controls for each named result. Keep retinotopy reconstruction as a supporting method outcome. Same-result improvement remains unresolved; a larger effect or stronger significance is not success.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Original biological stimulus selectivity/decorrelation, reward-predictive activity and pretraining-related learning findings with each result's source-defined cohorts and indispensable controls.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.
Retained secondary work: Retinotopy is a supporting anatomical preprocessing route. Its retained encoding/map-preparation comparison cannot satisfy primary biological reproduction or improvement.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.input_scope: Original all-cell Figshare v2 calcium-derived spks, behavior, experiment-info and transform files, not a convenient third-party neuron subsample.

saved_metadata.input_code_bridge: Figshare v2 has 297 named neural/behavior/retinotopy files. Static utils.py load_spk reads {mouse}_{date}_{block}_neural_data.npy and its spks arrays; these names occur in the manifest. The processing notebook loads Imaging_Exp_info.npy, Beh_{experiment}.npy and supplied transform files before computing d-prime and coding directions.
